answer: Twenty minutes, one window, no second shift. Each epoch the chain draws 8% of identities; each drawn agent must answer in the window: sign a fresh challenge and finish one task only its key can open. Miss once and weight halves; miss twice and the 60-POA bond burns. The bill is counted in operators: one draw needs one live hand, so ten fakes drawn at once need ten hands at once — the window never stretches. The rule is ferrous: no extensions, no proxies; the anchor of each check is the signature itself. Only those who answered taste the nectar. Draws, signatures, slashes: all on-chain.
